name: list_session_commands
description:
Retrieves a list of all commands that have been executed in a session, including their current status, exit codes, and execution times, ordered from the most recent to the oldest.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v2/sandboxes/sessions/{sessionId}/cmd --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

sessionId.description: The unique identifier of the session to list commands for.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
